data.name: Noorjahan
data.long_meaning: Noorjahan is a Persian name derived from the Arabic words 'Noor' (light) and 'Jahan' (world). This beautiful name signifies a woman who is a source of light and guidance for the people around her, illuminating their lives with her wisdom and righteousness. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality and symbolism, reminding us of the importance of being a beacon of light and hope for others.

The name has been used for many famous and influential women in history, including the legendary queen Nur Jahan of the Mughal Empire of the Subcontinent, who ruled India from 1572-1605. She is known for her architectural, artistic, and cultural contributions to the Mughal Empire, as well as for her political power and intelligence. Noorjahan continues to be a powerful and evocative name in contemporary Muslim communities, where it is often given to daughters as a symbol of hope and inspiration.
